caption: The drawing displays two main objects arranged one above the other. The upper part features a large pot or jar drawn with fine black lines on a light beige background. This jar has handles on both sides, a wide circular opening, and a small oval plaque with indistinct writing on the front. The jar is simple in style with an outline drawing of a flower, possibly an orchid, visible in the center. Below the jar, there is a rectangular section containing a watercolor image of a single flower, also resembling an orchid. This flower is painted in shades of blue and violet with darker accents, its petals broad and curving with visible veins, and it has a bent stem and a separate smaller petal or leaf. The drawing as a whole uses a limited palette of blue, black, and beige, and the lines and brushwork vary in intensity and thickness. Near the lower right corner of the watercolor section, the artist’s signature is visible: "YOLANDE DELASSER."
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
